plotSections.title: Party split
bullets: Sylan and Gerk take the ghosts. Dana, Walker, Ord, and Ciri go to Carlkin.
Dana's limits for Gerk: no doors to nothing-dimensions, no abyssal monsters, and no doors opened from moving vehicles.
They plan to regroup for dinner at the castle and plan the next step. Sylan treats that meetup as settled.

plotSections.title: Mind training
bullets: A half-elf-looking man about 5'10"–5'11", who has an ancient copper dragon, hears that Gerk still needs doorway training and says that makes two students, with Walker the other. He is willing to train them. Walker is to take the helm to be investigated, then return to training.

He pokes Gerk in the midriff and says Gerk is strong of body but lacking in mind. He calls it potential, not an insult: one does not insult an oak while it is a sapling. He tells Gerk to grow in the mind and says Walker needs help meditating.

Dana tells Gerk meditation is quieting the mind, the same focus used to open a door. She says thinking of nothing opens doors into the abyss. Gerk says he does not have that quiet, and that the abyss happens only when he thinks of nothing.

Dana says the rage still matters but must be channeled, and that doors are a separate act of focus. Gerk thinks raging while opening a door would go badly. Sylan recalls the seventeen-foot door; Gerk says that time he only tried to open it harder. Sylan suggests he try rage on a later training door.

plotSections.title: Carlkin
bullets: Sylan is heading to New Navel and asks Dana to warn Carlkin they are returning today. He says they are not within five hundred feet, and that last time they arrived without an appointment, opened a portal to the abyss, and he broke Carlkin's floor.
Walker asks why they cannot just walk in. Dana says they are lucky Carlkin allowed another appointment and that she had thought he might refuse to see them again.
Sylan warns Carlkin may be badly hung over and suggests a snack and maybe a lesser restoration from Ord. Dana says they will sort it out.

Dana casts Sending: they are heading that way, and Gerk and Sylan are not with them. She says Carlkin has an opening and the Carlkin group needs to leave now. Walker is with that group and is not flying off. Ord is taking the helm to Carlkin.

plotSections.title: Lantern and spirits
bullets: Sylan borrows the fused lantern-staff from Ord. Ord wants to test whether a different user gets a different effect and says he will tell Sylan the activation phrase. The exact words are not spoken in this stretch.

Sylan will take the fused item to Shades and Trades to identify it in its new state. Neither he nor Ord is sure that identification already happened. Taking it from Ord does not immediately cause a disaster.

Sylan and Gerk leave to deal with ghosts. Sylan wants to use his sword first, in his own realm and before going down the veil, because the sword takes him somewhere he can see spirits. If those spirits are there, he means to get them out; he says it is not a good place to be.

chronologicalEvents: Sylan assigns himself and Gerk to the ghosts and the others to Carlkin. Dana forbids doors to nothing-dimensions, abyssal monsters, and doors from moving vehicles.

Sylan tells Walker that Gerk can manipulate doors somewhat better after training but still needs work. The copper-dragon's half-elf companion offers to train both Gerk and Walker, and sends Walker to have the helm investigated first.
The trainer pokes Gerk, calls him strong of body and weak of mind, and compares him to an oak sapling. He says the work is in Gerk's mind and that Walker needs meditation.

Dana explains mental focus for doors, including that thinking of nothing opens the abyss. She separates that focus from Gerk's rage. Gerk doubts raging through a door; the seventeen-foot door is recalled as him simply opening it harder.

Sylan asks Dana to Send Carlkin notice of their return to New Navel. The group recounts the unannounced visit, the abyss portal, and the broken floor. Dana thinks another appointment was a near thing. Sylan suggests Carlkin may be hung over.
Dana's Sending says they are on the way and that Gerk and Sylan are not coming. She reports that Carlkin has an opening now.
The reunion is set for dinner at the castle. Sylan takes Gerk to the ghosts.
Ord lends Sylan the fused lantern-staff to test another wielder and to identify at Shades and Trades. Sylan plans to check the sword's spirit-place for spirits before going down the veil.
The split is confirmed: Sylan and Gerk to New Navel for the ghosts; Walker, Ord, Dana, and Ciri to Carlkin with the helm. Sylan offers Ciri a door as that group leaves.

Gerk.existing: Half-orc barbarian, Doorman and Child of the Great Eldarin Tree.
notes: Sylan says recent training let Gerk manipulate doors a little better, with more work still needed.
The copper-dragon companion judges him strong of body and lacking in mind, and offers to train that mind. Gerk hears it as an insult until it is framed as an oak growing from a sapling.

He says he cannot quiet his mind. He says doors open to the abyss only when he thinks of nothing, not as a general failure of focus. He thinks raging while opening a door would go poorly. On the seventeen-foot door he tried to open it harder rather than raging.
He goes with Sylan to New Navel to deal with ghosts, and is not part of the Carlkin visit. Dana tells Carlkin that in the Sending.
personality: Takes the trainer's mind comment personally, then laughs it off once Ord and the trainer recast it as future growth.
Says getting bigger would be inconvenient because he already barely fits places.
quotesThemes: "No, that's only if I think about nothing."

notes: Pairs with Gerk as the ghost pair and leaves Carlkin to the others.
Reports Gerk's partial progress with doors and accepts more training.
Asks Dana to warn Carlkin, citing the last unannounced visit, the abyss portal, and the floor he broke. Suggests Carlkin may be hung over and that Ord could use lesser restoration.
Sets the regroup at dinner in the castle.
Borrows the fused lantern-staff, asks for its activation wording, and plans to have the fused state identified at Shades and Trades.

Says his sword lets him travel to another place where he can see spirits. He wants to check that place in his realm before going down the veil, and to remove any spirits there because it is not a good place.
Says a reincarnation that leaves someone with a tail is not for him, and that his appearance has already changed from one experience.
personality: Treats the dinner plan as decided once he announces it.
quotesThemes: "Let's go, old Gerk. It's time to talk to ghosts."
"If they are, I need to get them out of there. 'Cause it's not a good place to be."
openQuestions: Are the spirits present in the place his sword opens, and do they need to be removed?
Has the fused lantern-staff already been identified at Shades and Trades?

Dana.existing: Half-elf cleric, most knowledgeable of the group, Gatekeeper of the Pitel keystone.
notes: Bars Gerk from doors to nothing-dimensions, abyssal monsters, and doors opened in moving vehicles.
Tells Gerk that door focus is a quiet mind, and that thinking of nothing brings the abyss. She says his rage is still the point but must be channeled, and that doors are a separate ability.
Sends to Carlkin that the group is heading there without Gerk and Sylan. She believes they are lucky he allowed another appointment. She then says he has an opening and the Carlkin group must go.
quotesThemes: "Please no doors to nothing dimensions. Please no abyssal monsters. No opening doors in moving vehicles."
"The rage is the whole thing, but the rage needs to be channeled appropriately, and the doors are an entirely separate ability to focus."

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider and fighter bonded to Glimmen, Gatekeeper of The Reach.
notes: The trainer says Walker will be free to return to training after the helm is investigated, and that Walker needs help meditating.
He is with the Carlkin group and is not flying off. He asks why they cannot simply walk in on Carlkin.
Tells Gerk that being called strong of body is something.

Gives Sylan the fused lantern-staff and proposes testing whether a different user changes the effect. He knows the activation phrase and says he will tell Sylan; the words themselves are not spoken here.
He is not sure they already had the fused item identified.
Sylan points to him for a possible lesser restoration if Carlkin is hung over. The helm goes with him to Carlkin.
quotesThemes: "Hey man, at least you're strong of body."
openQuestions: Does a different user activating the fused lantern-staff get a different effect?

Carlkin.existing: Turtle-like person; his lighthouse in New Navel is his home and bookshop.
notes: The party is seeking another appointment so the helm can be investigated. Dana remembers him as close to refusing them after they arrived without warning, opened a portal to the abyss, and Sylan broke his floor.
Sylan thinks he may be badly hung over.
Dana's Sending omits Gerk and Sylan on purpose. She then says he has an opening and the visiting group should go immediately.
A man who looks remotely half-elf and stands about 5'10" to 5'11", accompanying an ancient copper-colored dragon. Gerk already knew of the dragon and did not know the man's height.
He offers to train Gerk's mind and to help Walker meditate, and he pokes Gerk in the midriff. He tells Walker to have the helm investigated and then come back to training.
He says Gerk is strong of body but lacking in mind, and that this is not an insult.
personality: Instructs by prodding and by talking about future growth rather than by calling the judgment an insult.
quotesThemes: "You seem to be strong of body, but your mind seems to be lacking. We will work that out of you."
"One does not insult an oak tree as a sapling. They just know one day it'll be more."
"Not big in here. But big in there, your mind, boy."

Hanzuni.existing: Ancient copper dragon of Haven Hold who loans gold for quests.
notes: The trainer is described as having an ancient copper-colored dragon with him. Gerk already knew that dragon was his. No new action from the dragon itself in this stretch.

Fused lantern-staff.existing: Fused lantern and staff that reveals the Ethereal Plane and draws nearby spirits when the active staff is held.
notes: Ord hands it to Sylan. They intend to test whether another wielder changes the effect. Sylan will take it to Shades and Trades for identification in its fused state; they are unsure that was already done.
Ord has the activation phrase and will tell Sylan. It is not spoken here. Nothing catastrophic happens when Sylan takes it.
openQuestions: Does a different wielder change how it activates?
Has the fused state already been identified?

Helm.existing: A helm Carlkin agreed to examine by appointment once a comrade returns.
notes: The trainer tells Walker to take the helm and have it investigated before returning to meditation training. Ord confirms it is going to Carlkin with that group.

Sylan's sword.existing: Opens a gray spirit field where Sylan turns ghostly and can pull spirits toward himself.
notes: Sylan says it lets him travel to another place where he can see spirits like the ones they are going after. He plans to look for them there, in his realm, before going down the veil, and to remove them if they are present.
openQuestions: Are those spirits in the sword's other place?

Doorway.existing: Gerk's doorway ability, a fixed supernatural passage between locations.
notes: Sylan reports Gerk can manipulate doors a little better and still needs training.

Dana's stated failures to avoid: nothing-dimensions, abyssal monsters, and opening doors in moving vehicles. She says thinking of nothing is what opens the abyss, and that door focus is separate from rage.
The seventeen-foot door comes up as a prior attempt where Gerk tried to open it harder. Sylan suggests trying rage at the next training session. Gerk expects that to go poorly.

Shades and Trades.existing: Where Sylan found the staff later fused to Ord's lantern.
notes: Sylan plans to bring the fused lantern-staff here to identify it in its new state.

New Navel.existing: Familiar stop that holds Carlkin's lighthouse.
notes: Sylan and Gerk head there for the ghosts. The other group is going to Carlkin, who is there, after Dana's Sending. Sylan believes the party is farther than five hundred feet from Carlkin, so the warning has to be sent.

The trainer repeats and hunts for the word while saying they will work the lack out of Gerk's mind.
Sylan is talking about the trainer's lessons.
Sylan names the destination in the same breath as Carlkin.
Sylan restates the split: he and Gerk go there, the others go to Carlkin.

DM calling a player name while sorting who is in which group. Sylan has just said Ari.

Has the fused lantern-staff already been identified at Shades and Trades?
Are the spirits inside the place Sylan's sword opens, and does he need to get them out?

newTerms.name: Seventeen-foot door
notes: A prior doorway-training attempt. Sylan ties it to Gerk trying to force a door; Gerk says he only tried to open it harder.

newTerms.name: Ghost cop
notes: Sylan's name for the ghost errand he and Gerk are taking, played against the others' visit to Carlkin. Ord asks how Gerk is supposed to be bad cop if he cannot threaten them.
